prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a fresh candid editorial photo for a Brazilian family education Instagram carousel. Landscape 3:2. Fictional Brazilian father about 38 years old with medium brown skin, short dark curly hair and a little stubble, navy cotton T-shirt, seated at a light wood desk using a desktop computer keyboard with his left hand, mouse with his right. His fictional 11-year-old son with similar skin, curly black hair, yellow T-shirt is sitting next to him, turned toward father with an excited playful smile, inviting him to find a hidden treasure in the game. Father's face shows curiosity, both eyes toward the monitor. Camera across the desk at a three-quarter side angle: both faces visible on the left and middle, monitor screen clearly visible on the right. The screen must depict the supplied REAL platform game reference: red low-poly little car seen from behind in a grassy green low-poly forest, cyan secret pillar. The supplied image is ONLY the supporting insert for the monitor; do not copy it into the whole photograph. Match its simple low-poly geometry and don't invent a polished third-party game. Keep the entire monitor screen within frame. Natural lived-in tidy home, cream wall, subtle blue and yellow decor, warm soft daylight, convincing natural skin and hands. Realistic Brazilian middle-class home, not a computer lab, no luxury styling. The child is not using a controller or pointing randomly: he is inviting the father to play. No added text, labels, banners, logos or watermarks. Adults and child are wholly fictitious and not celebrity likenesses.

Use case: infographic-diagram. A beautiful hand-painted editorial plan for a child designing a treasure hunt, wide landscape 3:2. Direct overhead view of a cream drawing sheet, sparse textured color pencil and gouache strokes, rich navy ink, warm yellow, green foliage. ONE sandy path starts at bottom center with a little simple entrance gate, curves upward and divides clearly into TWO branches. Left branch leads to a large gray boulder with a tentative golden treasure chest doodle sketched beside it. Right branch leads to a cluster of three forest trees with a second tentative golden chest doodle tucked behind them. Both chests have loose unfinished pencil construction lines so these read as alternative possible hiding spots, not two treasures in one real game. On the right branch a small bright cyan glint, with four thin radiating strokes, provides an obvious visual clue leading toward the trees. Draw a simple curved navy arrow along that branch. Very clear visual hierarchy, ample breathing room, cheerful editorial style. It should look like a brainstorm on paper, NEVER a screenshot or map feature of a game. Paper fills whole canvas, no photographed table, no hands, no people, no UI. No text, no letters, no question marks, no numbers, no labels, no compass, no watermark. No rivers or water.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: editorial illustration for carousel P31 slide 3, not a screenshot of an actual game. Make a polished playful paper-cut / painted dimensional illustration, wide landscape 3:2. Two equal panels separated by a slim clean ivory gutter. Left panel: a big attractive golden treasure chest sitting obviously in the middle of a short sandy trail RIGHT at a small wooden entrance gate, a few stylized trees, the discovery is far too easy. Right panel: a small golden chest barely visible deep inside a cluster of ten tall blue-gray stone wall segments forming an unnecessarily confusing maze, trees around it, clearly far harder to find. Exactly two chests total, one in each panel. Both panels viewed in slight isometric perspective, clearly an editorial metaphor on an ivory paper background. Elegant simple forms, rich tactile texture, clean shadows, blue #194bd7, muted green, warm yellow #ffdb56, cream #fffcf4. Make the contrast immediately understandable with no text. No numbers, words, letters, UI, logos, water, people, arrows or labels. Fill most of the canvas with the two scenes and leave a small margin. Walls should not look like a real platform tool or actual game screenshot. Detailed handsome editorial art.
